```{r}
reset_baselines <- function(data, baselines) {
  for (var in names(baselines)) {
    if (var %in% names(data)) {
      data[[var]] <- relevel(factor(data[[var]]), ref = baselines[[var]])
    } else {
      warning(paste("Variable", var, "not found in data. Skipping."))
    }
  }
  return(data)
}
```




```{r}
set.seed(39748)
n <- nrow(dataset)
train_index <- sample(1:n, size = floor(0.8 * n))
training_dataset <- dataset[train_index, ]
testing_dataset <- dataset[-train_index, ]
```

```{r}
# Define baselines
baselines <- list(
  gor_x = 7,
  w3parqualmp = 4,
  w4concenyp = 2,
  w4lnpar = 2,
  w9danvqh = 4,
  w9dvnvqh = 3,
  w9drussell = 3,
  marital_status_MP = 2,
  job_attd = 3,
  w2hiqualgmp = 3
)
```

```{r}
# Reset baseline levels
training_dataset <- reset_baselines(training_dataset, baselines)
testing_dataset  <- reset_baselines(testing_dataset, baselines)
```



```{r}
# Set up method vector with names
method <- rep("pmm", ncol(dataset))
names(method) <- colnames(dataset)

method[which(names(dataset) %in% categorical_vars)] <- "polyreg"
method[which(names(dataset) %in% binary_vars)] <- "logreg"
```

```{r}
# Run mice on training set
imputed_training_data <- mice(training_dataset, m = 25, method = method, seed = 39748)
```

```{r}
# Run mice on testing set
imputed_testing_data <- mice(testing_dataset, m = 25, method = method, seed = 39748)
```

```{r}
# to save
saveRDS(imputed_training_data, file = "imputed_training_data.rds")
saveRDS(imputed_testing_data, file = "imputed_testing_data.rds")

# to load
# mids <- readRDS("imputed_training_data.rds")
```






Simple Log Reg

```{r}
logreg_fit <- with(imputed_training_data, glm(
  w9_income_above_median ~ idacirscore_y + w2sexyp + w4ghq12scr + w2ethnicyp + w2fat5yp + bullied + truant + 
  w2hiqualgmp + w3outschbyp + w7heflag + w9danvqh + w9dvnvqh + w9drussell + imdrscore_y + gor_x + 
  marital_status_MP + w4lnpar + w3parqualmp + w4readsyp + w4concenyp + w4noconfyp + drugs + job_attd + 
  w6univyp, 
  family = binomial
))

pooled_logreg_fit <- pool(logreg_fit)
# summary(pooled_logreg_fit)

significant_sorted <- summary(pooled_logreg_fit) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(estimate))

significant_sorted
```



```{r}
set.seed(39748)
# --- Step 0: Define the model formula (if not already defined) ---
formula_str <- w9_income_above_median ~ idacirscore_y + w2sexyp + w4ghq12scr + 
  w2ethnicyp + w2fat5yp + bullied + truant + w2hiqualgmp + w3outschbyp + w7heflag + 
  w9danvqh + w9dvnvqh + w9drussell + imdrscore_y + gor_x + marital_status_MP + 
  w4lnpar + w3parqualmp + w4readsyp + w4concenyp + w4noconfyp + drugs + job_attd + 
  w6univyp

# --- Step 2: Extract models and testing datasets ---
models <- logreg_fit$analyses  # list of glm models
test_list <- lapply(1:25, function(i) complete(imputed_testing_data, i))  # list of test sets

# --- Step 3: Predict probabilities on each imputed test dataset ---
pred_list <- vector("list", length = 25)

for (i in 1:25) {
  model_i <- models[[i]]
  test_i <- test_list[[i]]

  # Predict probabilities for test set i
  pred_list[[i]] <- predict(model_i, newdata = test_i, type = "response")
}

# --- Step 4: Average predictions across imputations ---
pred_matrix <- do.call(cbind, pred_list)   # rows = observations, cols = imputations
final_preds <- rowMeans(pred_matrix)       # average predicted probability per observation
pred_class <- ifelse(final_preds > 0.5, 1, 0)

# --- Step 5: Evaluate performance ---
# Get true labels from one imputed test set (they're the same across imputations)
true_labels <- test_list[[1]]$w9_income_above_median

# Accuracy
accuracy <- mean(pred_class == true_labels)
cat("Accuracy:", accuracy, "\n")

# AUC
roc_result <- roc(true_labels, final_preds)
cat("AUC:", auc(roc_result), "\n")

# Optional: plot ROC curve
plot(roc_result, main = "ROC Curve - Pooled Predictions")

```
